description: Dated closing prices and volumes for each researched stock. Points up to 5 Nov come from news and NGX price lists, and their volumes may be undercounted. 6 Nov comes from NGX's own data via your ngxprices tool. 9 and 10 Nov come from GTI Research's published NGX price lists. 11 Nov closes are official (Okomu Oil corrected to ₦1,137.10); its volumes are official for six stocks and from the live snapshot for the rest. 12 and 13 Nov come from APT Securities' NGX price lists, cross-checked against GTI Research. Seplat's 13 Nov close (₦16,241.90) is ex-dividend. Linkage Assurance's 13 Nov volume (3.1 billion shares) is as APT printed it and looks unusual; treat it with caution until the official file confirms it.
